X.note: The dark, empty void with a faint grid floor has no sense of place. The three cubes are tiny and sit in the middle of the frame, with the top half empty. The 13% label is semi-transparent and washed out, and its text collides with the green cube. The 7% label panel covers the orange cube's top. The cube heights don't match the values: 6% and 13% look nearly the same size as 7%. The cubes don't need three 'ACTUAL' badges plus a fourth in the corner, which is redundant. The bottom caption and source lines are legible.

Y.note: A real terrain map with a river gives a clear sense of place and a more cinematic look. The dark label cards have strong contrast and clean typography, and the layout is well spaced with no overlaps. The objects are small and sparse. The coins, bar, cube and document icon don't clearly show what they stand for, and no scale or numbers connect the objects to the labels ('~5 ships/yr' sits beside a bar and a cube, so it is unclear which one it labels). The map's bottom fade makes the caption legible.

why: Y has a grounded location, clean non-overlapping high-contrast labels and a clear mix of document, price and quantity objects, while X is a near-empty dark void with overlapping, washed-out labels and unclear cubes.
top_fix_for_weaker: Make the cubes much larger and scale their heights to 6, 7 and 13. Put them in a lit scene with a clear subject, such as a building or stairwell. Move each label off its cube, with a leader line, and give all three the same opaque card so the 13% text is readable. Remove the repeated ACTUAL badges.
